name: What should I look for when choosing a custom home builder?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a custom home builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a custom home builder, prioritize experience, reputation, and transparency. Look for builders with a strong portfolio of custom homes, positive client testimonials, and clear communication regarding timelines and budgets. Verify their licensing and insurance. A reputable builder should also demonstrate expertise in local building codes and regulations, especially in specific Los Angeles communities, and offer a collaborative approach to design and construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for experience, a strong portfolio, positive testimonials, transparent communication, proper licensing, and local building code expertise.
